title: Oil & Gas Hot Work Permit (Enhanced)
description: Free Oil & Gas Hot Work Permit (Enhanced) template for oil & gas you can edit online and download as PDF. Covers permit information, risk assessment & hazard identification, equipment inspection checklist.

Risk Assessment & Hazard Identification

Check all hazards applicable to this hot work:

FIRE / EXPLOSION HAZARDS: HEALTH / PHYSICAL HAZARDS:

☐ Flammable liquids stored nearby ☐ UV / Arc flash (eye injury)

☐ Combustible dust / fibers ☐ Burns from hot metal / slag

☐ Openings in floors/walls (spark entry) ☐ Noise >85dB

☐ Combustible floors (wood, etc.) ☐ Electrical shock

☐ Pits / trenches / sewers nearby ☐ Compressed gases (cylinders)

☐ Process equipment in service ☐ Manual handling

☐ Hydrocarbon lines / equipment ☐ Slips / trips / falls

☐ Hydrogen Sulfide (H2S) potential ☐ Working at height

ENVIRONMENTAL HAZARDS: OTHER HAZARDS:

☐ Hot work near environmentally sensitive area ☐ Confined / enclosed space

☐ Spill potential (cooling water, etc.) ☐ SIMOPS - Other activities nearby

☐ Weather / wind (spread of sparks) ☐ Night work / low visibility

☐ Lightning risk ☐ Remote location

FIRE WATCH RESPONSIBILITIES:

☐ Continuously monitor for fires and sparks during hot work operations

☐ Maintain fire extinguishing equipment immediately available and ready for use

☐ Watch for fires in all exposed areas, including floors above and below

☐ Attempt to extinguish any fires that start within the capability of available equipment

☐ Sound alarm and evacuate if fire cannot be controlled

☐ Monitor area for at least 30 minutes (minimum) after hot work ceases

☐ Conduct final inspection of work area before leaving
